changelog:
WHAT'S NEW
• Phones and tablets: the full app sideways, sized to fit, with touch scrolling
• Snow Originals: our own videos, right in Live TV
• Rewind live TV, record channels and schedule recordings from the Guide
• Game Day: all your lines with service tags, more soccer (internationals, Europe, Liga MX), smarter channel finding (B1G+, SEC+, ESPN+ events and more), report a channel down
• The whole app in English, Español, Français, Deutsch or العربية
• New Home look and a new How to use SMC guide with real screenshots
• Plex plays smoother on slower connections, and changing quality works
• Hold OK on a channel for a quick menu; sign-in keyboard jumps to Sign in
releaseNotes: Version 1.8.3: On phones and tablets SMC now opens sideways and full screen, sized to fit, and works by touch (scroll by finger, tap to select, Back steps back). Snow Originals, our own videos in Live TV. Rewind live TV, record channels and schedule recordings from the Guide. Game Day uses every line you're signed into with a tag for each service, adds international and European soccer, lets you report a channel that's down, and lists only channels the guide confirms. The whole app now speaks English, Spanish, French, German or Arabic (Settings → Language). A new Home look, a new How to use SMC guide with real screenshots, smoother Plex on slower connections (and changing the quality now works), a quick hold-OK channel menu, and the sign-in keyboard now jumps straight to Sign in.
